entities.summary: Uda Mikumari Shrine is a Shinto shrine located in Uda, Nara, Japan. It is dedicated to mikumari, a female Shinto kami associated with water. The honden was built near the end of the Kamakura period, and is listed as a National Treasure of Japan. Uda Mikumari Shrine is a Shinto shrine in Asia, established in 1320. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
